observation: Fresh main already treats ROLLED_BACK and FAILED as terminal RunStore states, but TaskStore.syncRun maps them onto apply/repair as a currently running task. The task projection therefore claims ongoing work after the owning run has terminated even though blocked/failed task states already exist.
changes: Preserve the existing phase projection, but project the current apply task as blocked for ROLLED_BACK and the current repair task as failed for FAILED.
Ensure neither terminal run state leaves an owned task marked running.
Do not invent new task states, recovery policy, retry behavior, or post-terminal phases.
